body: I feel a gentle tug, as if the air around me is vibrating with an unfamiliar scent. The aroma of fresh food wafts through my senses, drawing me closer to the scene. I approach cautiously, my paws padding softly on the ground. As I draw nearer, I notice the stray dogs, all of them, sleeping soundly beside each other. They appear to be some sort of pack, their fur matted with dirt and grime. I sense a deep loyalty and trust among them, a sense of safety and belonging that I don't often experience.
